apiKey.description: DashScope API key from pluginConfig.apiKey. Optional at install time; required before tool calls.

createTaskUrl.description: Optional override for async task creation URL from pluginConfig.createTaskUrl; defaults to the DashScope video synthesis endpoint.

taskResultBaseUrl.description: Optional override for task result base URL from pluginConfig.taskResultBaseUrl; defaults to https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/api/v1/tasks.
